snippet.title: Project KNUCKLE BUSTERS Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Classic arcade-style side-scrolling beat 'em up action game KNUCKLE BUSTERS (working title) is officially in development!

アーケード風ベルトスクロールアクション新作『ナックルバスター』（仮称）開発中です！

Follow our socials and join the community!

https://www.youtube.com/@UCDvMWZVFCxi7ROVfSyFg4mg 
https://x.com/KBustersGame 
https://bsky.app/profile/knucklebusters.bsky.social

https://discord.gg/K4MMMCDYjp



created by Jiggeh and gsaurus
https://www.youtube.com/@UCst6brFoWURPqjV7BsbnY2g 
https://www.youtube.com/@gsaurus

Stay tuned for more information and announcements!
